count_semantics: Unique canonical attempted page URLs; search result URLs not opened are not included. Find/open repeats and two PDF screenshots are not additional unique pages. This is not an HTTP request count. Each source timestamp is the batch receipt; the recorded retrieval window bounds actual calls.
